audit.why: Lane difficulty 4/10 FAV matches the 58.33% Emerald+ win rate over 444 games; the level chart (Sejuani 5, Skill 2, Locke 0) does not contradict the data.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the level-6 Purgatory threat but never stated what Purgatory actually does to Sejuani beyond the execute.
audit.why: Purgatory carries a grounding component (kit flags: grounding, execute, zone, slow). Grounding denies Arctic Assault, which is Sejuani's only disengage — that is the real spike, not just the execute number.
audit.corrected: Level-6 spike now states the grounding as well as the execute floor.

audit.whatIsWrong: No line anywhere connected Locke's Ashen Pursuit (E) cooldown, Ritual Nails (Q) cooldown, or Soul Ignition (W) end-of-duration refund to Sejuani's play pattern; one line also claimed Permafrost 'cancels his E dash'.
audit.why: Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s at every rank, Ritual Nails is 10/9/8/7/6s, and Soul Ignition (18/17/16/15/14s) heals back a portion of its self-damage AT THE END of the effect — so Grievous Wounds has to be applied before it expires. Whether a stun applied mid-dash cancels Ashen Pursuit is not in Riot's text, so that claim was removed rather than restated.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers and the Soul Ignition anti-heal timing are now stated; the unverifiable dash-cancel claim is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said Ashen Pursuit 'resets on takedowns'.
audit.why: Riot's description says only that Locke teleports then dashes to attack his next target. No takedown reset is stated, and the cooldown field is a flat 10 at all ranks.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the verifiable flat 10s figure.

audit.why: Soul Ignition's refund is a heal and Grievous Wounds reduces it, but only if applied before the effect ends.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line now carries the timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ashen Pursuit's auto-attack reset was never used as a tell.
audit.why: The kit flags autoReset on E — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue.
audit.corrected: Left for a later pass; the grounding and cooldown facts were the higher-value additions inside the length band.

edits.after: Permafrost stuns him mid-trade; his E is a flat 10s exit he cannot recycle.

edits.before: Purgatory forces the first respect of the lane — stop trading at execute-range HP.
edits.after: Purgatory's zone grounds Arctic Assault — walk out before execute-range HP.

edits.before: Permafrost saved for his E dash
edits.after: Permafrost held for his 10s E dash

edits.before: Level 3 Permafrost stun cancels his E dash and locks down any trade he dares to start.
edits.after: Level 3 Permafrost stuns him out of any trade, and his E is a flat 10s exit he spends.

edits.before: Purgatory changes the rules: fights now end at HIS floor — disengage above ~15% or leave the totem zone entirely.
edits.after: Purgatory changes the rules: fights end at HIS execute floor, and its zone grounds Arctic Assault — walk out, don't dash.

edits.before: - Locke Ritual Nails (Marks): matchup-defining — The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Track it before every step-up. - Locke E (Ashen Pursuit): his ONLY mobility, resets on takedowns — the post-E window is the lane. - Locke R (Purgatory): never fight at sliver HP inside the zone.
edits.after: - Locke Ritual Nails (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s): his engine — without marks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the gap. Track it before every step-up. - Locke Ashen Pursuit (E): a flat 10s at every rank, his only mobility and his only exit — the post-E window is the lane. - Locke R (Purgatory): its zone grounds Arctic Assault — never fight at sliver HP inside it.

edits.before: Locke wastes Ritual Nails — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Its zone grounds you: Arctic Assault will not fire — walk out.

edits.before: E is his engage AND escape — a spent blink is the lane’s biggest cooldown; don’t waste yours before it.

notes: Two claims left untouched because they cannot be verified from the kit files: full.phases[0].why calls Locke 'a 125-range mana champ' (no attack-range field in the kit) and report[9]/phases[5] name a Lich Bane spike (no item data in the kits). The _missing-interactions entry 'Locke bypasses stacking resistances (Soul Ignition (W))' looks like a derived-flag misfire: Riot's text says Soul Ignition damages LOCKE HIMSELF, so the trueDamage flag is self-damage, not damage that ignores Sejuani's resistances. I did not write that claim anywhere.
